choices.en: the tang monk asked guanyin for help.
wujing was surprised to see wukong at mount potalaka.
choices.zh: 悟净惊讶地在普陀山见到悟空。

choices.en: the two wukongs fought with their iron bars.

answer_evidence.quote: When Wujing arrived at Mount Potalaka, he was even more shocked.
Wukong was meditating in the bodhisattva's garden.
Wujing was surprised. "He has?"
Furious, Wukong pulled out his iron bar.
The fake Wukong pulled out his iron bar.
Wukong attacked, and so did the fake Wukong. Clang! The ground shook as the iron bars crashed into each other.

choices.en: wukong made fake versions of his companions.
choices.zh: 悟空制造了他同伴的假冒版本。

choices.en: he knew which one was the real wukong.
choices.zh: 他知道哪一个才是真正的悟空。

choices.en: the tang monk needed her help.

answer_evidence.quote: "Bodhisattva, I must speak with you. Wukong has made fake versions of me, Bajie, and the Tang Monk. He's planning to make the journey without us."
"I just saw him on the Fruit and Flower Mountain. I don't know how he got here before me."
"I don't know which one of you is the real Wukong," said Wujing.

sources.file: G:\Game\BookPlay书戏\data\测试题\08 英文测试题108集全.Journey to the West-quiz.pdf

prompt.en: who went to the fruit and flower mountain?

answer_evidence.quote: "Someone is pretending to be me! And he's living on my mountain! I'm going there right now. I'm going to destroy him!"
"I'll go with you," said Wujing.
Wukong and Wujing soon arrived on the Fruit and Flower Mountain.

choices.en: he didn't want to bother the tang monk.
he didn't know the tight headband spell.
choices.zh: 他不知道紧身头带咒语。

answer_evidence.quote: "I don't know which one of you is the real Wukong," said Wujing.
"Go to Mount Potalaka. Guanyin will be able to tell who is who. I will return to the Tang Monk to tell him what's going on."
"Guanyin will easily see that I am the real Wukong."
"Guanyin will easily see that I am the real Wukong."

prompt.en: what did the wukongs suggest to guanyin?

answer_evidence.quote: "I can't tell which one of you is the real Wukong," she said.
One Wukong took a deep breath.
"Use the Tight Headband spell. The spell will work only with my headband—the real headband."
"Yes!" said the other one.
"Use the Tight Headband spell! The spell will work only with my headband."
